name: Zoku Mikagura Shoujo Tanteidan ~Kanketsuhen~
original_name: 続・御神楽少女探偵団～完結編～
source:
This is the continuation of Mikagura Shoujo Tanteidan.
The events from the past will chase the members of the agency. Will they be able to outstand enemy's intrigues? And will be Tokito ready to find out the truth?
translation:
这是《神乐少女侦探团》的续作。
过去发生的事件将追上事务所成员。他们能否识破敌人的阴谋？时田又是否准备好查明真相？
